info.title: Mock Catalogue Service
info.description: Complete mock backend service for parsing schemas, payload structures, path variables, and testing security validation constraints on an API Gateway or WAF.

servers.description: Relative server path to support agnostic proxy forwarding and gateway routing logic.

BasicAuth.description: Basic Access Authentication using credentials validated via Ktor basic authentication.

get.description: Fetches an array containing all user entries recorded within the catalogue context.

200.description: A comprehensive list of user profiles.

post.summary: Create or retrieve a user record
post.description: Validates properties to register a user. If the email structure already exists, it maps the request back to the matched historical record to maintain single entity integrity.

201.description: User profile successfully instantiated or resolved from record lookups.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or malformed Basic Authentication credentials.

get.summary: Retrieve a single user identity profile
get.description: Inspects dataset criteria to match a specific unique primary numerical identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique numerical database primary key ID assigned to the specific user profile.

200.description: The target matching user dataset domain model.

400.description: The route segment reference is unmapped, missing, or cannot be successfully evaluated as a valid integer index parsing context.

404.description: The index query successfully parsed into an integer context but failed to match an ongoing entity mapping reference.

put.description: Enforces complete resource replacement context constraints, verifies matching profile data immutability, and executes an authenticating principal checking constraint logic boundary.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The target resource primary identity mapping constraint value context.

200.description: The target matching user dataset domain model.

400.description: Input format syntactic error or invalid manipulation attempts over non-mutable key properties.

401.description: The request lacks essential validation values or holds incorrect authorization formats.

403.description: The authenticated principal identity mismatches the resource value map permissions context boundaries.

schema.example: You can only update your own profile

404.description: The database cannot resolve a valid entity matching the provided identity mapping payload criteria.

delete.summary: Destructive resource eviction for an identity profile
delete.description: Parses path constraints to locate a profile, applies a principal validation guard check, and completely flags the entity for database layer eviction.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique numerical identifier pointing to the profile intended for permanent deletion.

204.description: Profile successfully evicted from the data mapping layers. No payload is returned.

400.description: The identity key segment is poorly formatted or fails integer conversion parsing.

401.description: Missing or fundamentally invalid access validation credentials context header.

403.description: Authorization token validation mismatch. Cross-tenant profile deletion attempts are prohibited.

schema.example: You can only delete your own profile

404.description: The targeted user account entity index reference cannot be discovered inside the volatile storage scope.
